nodes.label: Omniverse Cross-Device Sync Protocol
nodes.rationale: Specifies a peer-to-peer-like QR transfer mechanism that packages all API keys, settings, and Trakt auth tokens in a single standard base64-encoded JSON string (`OMNIVERSE-SYNC1:<base64>`) to bypass any central servers or external cloud storage dependencies.

nodes.label: QR Payload JSON Schema
nodes.rationale: Stable, compact JSON schema containing Trakt, TMDB, TVDB, Pixeldrain, and AniList credentials/tokens along with user settings. Omits watch history to stay under QR size constraints (fits within error correction level M).

nodes.label: QR Decode & Restore Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Verifies and strips the `OMNIVERSE-SYNC1:` prefix, decodes the base64 JSON payload, populates ApiCredentials and UserSettings, persists to secure storage (Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences), and refreshes AppState.

nodes.label: Cross-Platform Camera QR Scanner
nodes.rationale: Uses native camera pipelines (iOS: AVCaptureSession + AVCaptureMetadataOutput; Android: zxing-android-embedded ScanContract) to capture and decode QR codes instantly, falling back to secure manual paste.

nodes.label: Decentralized Client-Side Serverless Architecture
nodes.rationale: Direct public-API access keeps credentials, data ownership, and API limits under the user's control and avoids third-party servers.

nodes.label: Reliable AdShield Protection Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Telemetry reporting is null-safe and cannot interrupt blocking when the renderer is absent.

nodes.label: Trusted Update Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Desktop and Android accept only official HTTPS release assets of the expected type and reject credential, query, and traversal-shaped URLs.

nodes.label: Cinematic Multiscreen Experience
nodes.rationale: Large artwork, quiet controls, deep black surfaces, and luminous glass are adapted to each platform instead of stretching one interaction model across every screen.

nodes.label: Sync QR Security Warning
nodes.rationale: OMNIVERSE-SYNC1 QR payloads contain Base64-encoded credentials; Base64 is not encryption and a live code must be treated as a password.

nodes.label: Client-Side Media Disclaimer
nodes.rationale: Omniverse is a client application and does not host or distribute media.

nodes.label: Versioned Graphify Contributor Memory
nodes.rationale: Useful codebase queries are versioned alongside the graph so future investigations can reuse durable contributor knowledge.

nodes.label: Graphify Reflection Lessons
nodes.rationale: Preferred sources, corrections, and known dead ends are recorded for future investigations.

nodes.label: Lordflix-Inspired Visual System
nodes.rationale: The desktop shell explicitly ports a crimson Lordflix palette, black canvas, glass layers, and Lordflix-style navigation.

nodes.label: Shared Cinematic Crimson Design System
nodes.rationale: Mobile surfaces were redesigned to inherit the desktop atmosphere while preserving native SwiftUI and Compose behavior.

nodes.label: Pairing QR Redaction
nodes.rationale: The live iOS pairing QR was fully redacted to avoid publishing credentials.

nodes.label: Base64 Security Wording Correction
nodes.rationale: The README now accurately states that Base64 is encoding rather than encryption.

nodes.label: ProMotion Refresh Unlock
nodes.rationale: CADisableMinimumFrameDurationOnPhone prevents ProMotion devices from capping CADisplayLink and animations at 60Hz.

nodes.label: Limited App Transport Security Exceptions
nodes.rationale: API traffic remains under ATS while arbitrary loads are limited to user-selected media, web content, and local networking.

nodes.label: Platform-Native Execution
nodes.rationale: The clients share discovery, continuity, playback, state, repository, media-model, source-resolution, progress, and sync concepts while retaining native execution technologies on each platform.

nodes.label: Device-Controlled Credentials
nodes.rationale: The product avoids a central media host and keeps service credentials under device control.

nodes.label: Layered Cinematic Discovery
nodes.rationale: A full-bleed hero supplies atmosphere and a dominant playback choice while the provider rail offers a faster service-oriented route to content without leaving the home surface.

nodes.label: Live TV Master-Detail Layout
nodes.rationale: A narrow discovery column keeps regional filtering and channel selection visible beside a much larger playback surface, supporting rapid switching without obscuring the stream.

nodes.label: Visual-First Movie Browsing
nodes.rationale: A dense, evenly spaced grid prioritizes recognizable key art and fast visual scanning while reserving text for the page heading and persistent navigation.

nodes.label: Low-Distraction Query Entry
nodes.rationale: The search surface removes competing content before a query and concentrates attention on a large central input, leaving a dedicated results area ready to populate.
